text.card: A red giant 3,839 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.95 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,752 K at its surface.
